restricted_scope_policy.explanation: Restricted scopes (e.g., Gmail read/write, Drive) provide wide access to user data. Storing or transmitting restricted-scope data may require a Google security assessment. Refused for live use in v1.

sensitive_scope_policy.explanation: Sensitive scopes (e.g., Calendar, Admin Directory) require explicit verification posture before live use. Fixture-backed read allowed.

claim_boundaries.credential_safety: No raw access tokens, refresh tokens, client secrets, service account private keys, OAuth codes, or JWT assertions stored in any artifact.
